saggen-pearl.name: Saggen Pearl
saggen-pearl.description:
Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

Location: Duviri

scintillant.name: Scintillant
scintillant.description:
These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos

scuttler-husk.name: Scuttler Husk
scuttler-husk.description:
A remnant of battle with Oraxia, the spider that once wore this skin is gone… though it is not easy to tell where.

Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)

sentirum.name: Sentirum
sentirum.description:
A rare Eidolon Gem, created from the fossilized blood of an ancient Sentient.

Location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Blue Mining Veins and Thumper Bulls. This Rare Gem can only be mined by the Advanced Nosam Cutter or Sunpoint Plasma Drill.

seriglass-shard.name: Seriglass Shard
seriglass-shard.description:
Once part of an intricate Entrati apparatus, now shattered and bearing a sharp edge.

Location: Grandmother in the Necralisk on Deimos

servoris.name: Servoris
servoris.description:
Medals awarded to Orokin soldiers during The Old War for acts of distinguished service.

Location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).

shelter-debt-bond.name: Shelter Debt-Bond
shelter-debt-bond.description:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

shrill-voca.name: Shrill Voca
shrill-voca.description:
A Voidtongue cry, trapped in the stone. Crucial to unraveling the secrets of the Murmur.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)

silphsela.name: Silphsela
silphsela.description:
It is traditionally held that to see Silphsela floating in the air heralds an imminent change in the sky.

Location: Duviri

sister-of-parvos-token.name: Sister Of Parvos Token
sister-of-parvos-token.description: A token symbolizing a converted Sister of Parvos. Can be traded to other players for control of said Sister of Parvos.

sola-toroid.name: Sola Toroid
sola-toroid.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Sola Toroids from enemies located at the Temple of Profit in the Orb Vallis and from Kyta Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

son-token.name: Son Token
son-token.description:
A mark of Son's respect for services rendered.

Obtained from Son in the Necralisk on Deimos.

star-crimzian.name: Star Crimzian
star-crimzian.description:
Polished and cut to perfection.

Blueprint sold by Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus on Earth.

steel-essence.name: Steel Essence
steel-essence.description: Tokens of Teshin's Esteem earned from Incursion Alerts or Acolytes on The Steel Path. Can be exchanged for items that prove your warrior capabilities by visiting Teshin in any Relay.

stela.name: Stela
stela.description:
This Void-touched stone contains an ominous essence.

Location: Albrecht's Laboratories (Deimos)

sunlight-dragonlily.name: Sunlight Dragonlily
sunlight-dragonlily.description:
This uncommon plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Dragonlily plants that grow on Earth

sunlight-jadeleaf.name: Sunlight Jadeleaf
sunlight-jadeleaf.description:
This rare plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Jadeleaf plants that grow on Earth

sunlight-threshcone.name: Sunlight Threshcone
sunlight-threshcone.description:
This common plant can only be found during the day. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Sunlight Threshcone plants that grow on Earth
